raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 was re-delivered at 05:00 on 2026-01-19, and those rows duplicate existing txn_ids. Deduplicating silver_transactions on txn_id, keeping the earliest ingest, removes the duplicates and the doubled volume for 2026-01-18, and the gold tables then rebuild correctly from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1;"}}
